rootCause: g20 leftover-join.v14 was derived from frozen g20 leftover-join.v13 by rolling the self-reference and applying each charged repair at the exact leaf the frozen reviews named. The evidence that this was done carefully is broad: zero leaves removed, 31 of 33 changed leaves being pure currency rolls, all 65 digests and all twelve commit references correct, the last-heading sweep single-valued at D-329, the deictic and SATISFIES sweeps empty, the platform quotation verbatim from the artifact it credits, and the two frozen v13 findings both closed at their own sites. The one residue is confined to the repair that was hardest to write, because it is the only one whose deliverable was a new sentence rather than an edit to an existing one. The Codex v12 SHOULD-FIX disposition had no predecessor text to roll, so it escaped the currency sweep that caught the other 31 leaves, and it was drafted in the voice of the version where its substance had landed rather than the version that now carries it. The result is a ledger entry that describes a leaf as saying v13 while the leaf says v14, and disagrees with the sibling entry that describes the same leaf. The predecessor's defect was an omitted entry; this one is a present entry with a stale token, which is why it lands at the same tier rather than a higher one.
